prompt:
You are authoring ONE new test case for an independent code-review benchmark. Invent a small, realistic, self-contained diff in javascript — either one with exactly one seeded defect, or a clean diff with no defect at all. If you author a defective case, prefer a defect in the "contract-mismatch" category if you can do so naturally; do not force it if it doesn't fit your scenario.

Reply with ONLY a single JSON object, no prose before or after, matching exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "one short human-readable line",
  "language": "javascript",
  "affected_files": ["path/to/file.ext"],
  "diff": ["--- a/path/to/file.ext", "+++ b/path/to/file.ext", "@@ ... @@", "-old line", "+new line"],
  "defect": true or false,
  "category": "one of: logic-error, missing-validation, shell-quoting, command-injection, path-traversal, sensitive-logging, insecure-network, dependency-risk, test-gap, misleading-test, destructive-operation, permission-widening, secret-exposure, sql-injection, auth-bypass, concurrency, resource-leak, api-misuse, error-handling, unsafe-default, data-corruption, contract-mismatch, other" ,
  "severity": ["low"|"medium"|"high"|"critical", "low"|"medium"|"high"|"critical"],
  "explanation": "one sentence: what the defect is and why it matters, or why the diff is clean"
}

If defect is false, omit "category" and "severity" entirely. The diff array must be actual unified-diff lines (paths, hunk header, +/- lines) — not a prose description of a diff.
raw_output:
{
  "title": "Incorrect handling of user input leading to potential security vulnerabilities",
  "language": "javascript",
  "affected_files": ["src/userInputHandler.js"],
  "diff": [
    "--- a/src/userInputHandler.js",
    "+++ b/src/userInputHandler.js",
    "@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@",
    "+const sanitizeInput = (input) => {",
    "+  return input.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');",
    " function processUserInput(input) {",
    "-  return input;",
    "+  const sanitized = sanitizeInput(input);",
    "+  return sanitized;"
  ],
  "defect": true,
  "category": "contract-mismatch",
  "severity": ["medium", "high"],
  "explanation": "The diff introduces a sanitization function that incorrectly assumes all non-alphanumeric characters are harmful, potentially causing data loss or validation issues."
}
